segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמֵּבִיא גֵּט מִמְּדִינַת הַיָּם, וְאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לוֹמַר ״בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב וּבְפָנַי נֶחְתַּם״, אִם יֵשׁ עָלָיו עֵדִים – יִתְקַיֵּים בְּחוֹתְמָיו.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who brings a bill of divorce from a country overseas and is unable to say: It was written in my presence and it was signed in my presence, if» the bill of divorce «has witnesses» signed «on it, it should be ratified through its signatories.» The witnesses themselves or someone who recognizes their signatures should ratify it, in the manner of typical documents.

segments.he: אֶחָד גִּיטֵּי נָשִׁים וְאֶחָד שִׁחְרוּרֵי עֲבָדִים, שָׁווּ לַמּוֹלִיךְ וְלַמֵּבִיא, וְזוֹ אַחַת מִן הַדְּרָכִים שֶׁשָּׁווּ גִּיטֵּי נָשִׁים לְשִׁחְרוּרֵי עֲבָדִים.
segments.en: «Both bills of divorce and» bills «of manumission are the same with regard to» the halakhot of «delivering» the document from Eretz Yisrael to a country overseas «and with regard to bringing» it from a country overseas to Eretz Yisrael, i.e., the agents for both types of documents must declare that it was written and signed in their presence, and their statement is accepted. «And this is one of the ways in which» the halakhot of «bills of divorce are equal to» the halakhot of bills «of manumission.»

moves.cueHe: המביא גט ממדינת הים ואינו יכול לומר
אחד גיטי נשים ואחד שחרורי עבדים
moves.summary: divorce and manumission equal for delivering and bringing

positions.claim: if the bearer cannot declare, it is ratified through its signatories; divorce and manumission documents are alike
